description: Read-only CLI for your Zapier account: list zaps, check run history, diagnose failures.

novel_features.name: List and find Zaps
novel_features.description: List Zaps and filter by a case-insensitive title substring without changing them.

novel_features.name: Inspect run history
novel_features.description: List historical Zap runs with optional Zap and status filters.

novel_features.name: Open run step details
novel_features.description: Open one historical run and return every step's status, input, output, and error.

novel_features.name: Diagnose failed runs
novel_features.description: Resolve a Zap and report the exact failed step and error from recent failed runs.
